info.title: SaaS Gym Management System API

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description:
Step 1 of authentication. Returns an access token on success.
If the user's role requires MFA and it is enabled, returns
`requiresMfa: true` with a `tempToken` to complete step 2.

Submit the TOTP code + the tempToken received from /auth/login.
Returns a full access token and sets the refresh token cookie.

200.description: MFA verified — full access token issued

post.summary: Refresh access token using httpOnly cookie
post.description:
Reads the `refreshToken` httpOnly cookie, rotates it,
and returns a new short-lived access token.

Sends a time-limited reset link to the user's email.
Always returns success regardless of whether the email exists
(prevents user enumeration).

post.summary: Reset password using a token from the reset email
Log out and revoke the current refresh token

get.summary: Get the currently authenticated user's profile

post.summary: Change own password (also clears force-change flag)
post.description:
Requires the current password. On success all other sessions are revoked
and a fresh login is required.

400.description: Current password incorrect or new password too weak

post.summary: Initiate MFA setup — returns a QR code and secret
post.description:
Generates a TOTP secret and returns a QR code data URL.
Scan with Google Authenticator, Authy, or any RFC 6238-compatible app.
MFA is NOT enabled until /mfa/verify is called with a valid code.

post.summary: Verify TOTP code and activate MFA on the account

400.description: Invalid code or MFA setup not initiated

get.description: Paginated, filterable list of invoices. Supports filtering by member, branch, status, and overdue.

post.description:
Creates an invoice with one or more line items. Totals (subtotal, tax, discount, total)
are calculated server-side. Set `issueImmediately: true` to skip the draft state.

patch.description: Update line items, due date, memo, or notes. Only allowed on draft invoices.

400.description: Invoice is not in draft status

post.description: Transitions invoice from draft to issued, making it payable.
Voids an invoice. Fails if the invoice has recorded payments — refund payments first.

400.description: Cannot void invoice with recorded payments

post.summary: Apply a discount code to an invoice
post.description: Applies a valid discount code to a draft or issued invoice, recalculating totals.

get.summary: List branches for the current tenant
get.description: Returns all branches ordered by HQ first, then alphabetically.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by branch name or code

post.description:
Creates a branch for the authenticated tenant.
Enforces the `maxBranches` quota from the tenant's SaaS plan.
If `isHeadquarters` is true, the existing HQ branch is automatically demoted.

get.description: Returns branch details with populated manager profiles.

patch.description: Update branch name, address, contact info, timezone, or operating hours.

Set branch to active, inactive, or archived.
Archiving a branch will unassign all users from it.
The headquarters branch cannot be archived.

get.summary: List users assigned to a branch
get.description: Returns all staff, trainers, and members assigned to this branch.

post.summary: Assign a user to a branch
post.description:
Adds a branch-scoped user (BranchManager, Staff, Trainer, Member) to this branch.
Branch managers are also added to the branch's `managerIds` list.
GymOwner and SuperAdmin cannot be branch-assigned.

delete.summary: Remove a user from a branch
delete.description: Unassigns the user from this branch. Their account is not deleted.

post.description:
Validates member entitlement (active subscription, not frozen, not expired)
and records the check-in result. Returns `result: "allowed"` or `result: "blocked"`.
Blocked check-ins are still recorded for audit purposes.
Optimised for ≤1.5s response time (NFR-PRF-004).
Checks a discount code's validity and returns the computed discount amount without applying it.

patch.description: Update validity window, usage limits, or active status. Code and type cannot be changed.

get.description: Paginated list of equipment for the tenant. Filterable by branch, status, category, and overdue maintenance.

parameters.name: overdueMaintenanceOnly
parameters.description: Filter to equipment with overdue nextMaintenanceDue

post.description: Registers a new piece of equipment for a branch. Enforces unique assetTag and serialNumber per tenant.

patch.description: Updates equipment details including status and condition. Status change is audited separately.

delete.description: Soft-archives equipment and sets status to retired. Fails if there are open work orders.

get.description: Returns paginated maintenance logs for a piece of equipment, newest first.

post.description:
Records a maintenance event and updates the equipment's `lastMaintenanceAt`,
`condition`, and `nextMaintenanceDue`. If `maintenanceIntervalDays` is set and
`nextMaintenanceDue` is not provided, the next due date is auto-computed.

get.description: Tenant-wide paginated list of work orders. Filter by branch, equipment, status, priority, assignee, or overdue.

post.description:
Creates a maintenance/repair work order for a piece of equipment.
Critical priority orders automatically set equipment status to `under_maintenance`.

patch.description: Update status, priority, assignment, costs, or due date. Cannot update resolved/cancelled orders.

post.description:
Marks the work order as resolved. Optionally creates a linked maintenance log
and resets the equipment status to `operational`.

post.summary: Add a comment to a work order

get.description: Paginated, filterable list of expenses. Supports filtering by branch, category, status, and date range.

post.description: Record a new operational expense for a branch.

get.description: Monthly or yearly expense summary broken down by category, with optional branch filter.
Analytics overview — top categories, branch comparison, monthly spend trend for the past N months.

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: Number of past months to include

post.description: Attach a receipt URL (from uploaded file) to an expense. Maximum 10 receipts per expense.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the receipt to remove

post.description:
Creates a payment schedule for an issued invoice.
The schedule is auto-generated based on number of instalments and frequency.
Only one active instalment plan is allowed per invoice.

409.description: Active plan already exists for invoice

post.description: Records payment for a specific instalment, updates the schedule entry, and records a payment against the linked invoice.
Cancels the plan and unlinks it from the invoice. The invoice remains active and can be paid in full.

get.description: Paginated, filterable list of members for the authenticated tenant.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by name, email, or phone

post.description:
Creates a member profile for the tenant.
Enforces `maxMembers` quota from the SaaS plan.
`govId` is AES-256 encrypted before storage.

patch.description:
Changes member status with appropriate business logic:
- **active**: Reactivates member. If previously frozen, extends subscription by actual freeze days.
- **suspended**: Blocks gym access. Billing continues. Subscriptions preserved.
- **frozen**: Pauses gym access and billing. Subscription expiry extends when unfrozen.
- **inactive**: Deactivates member. Cancels all subscriptions.

get.description: Returns member details with active subscription and last 5 check-ins.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the member and cancels all active subscriptions.

get.description: Returns recent subscriptions, check-ins, and body measurements.

post.description: Creates a new subscription for the member. Only one active subscription allowed at a time.

Temporarily freezes a subscription until the specified resume date.
The end date is automatically extended by the freeze duration.

get.summary: Get check-in history for a member
Get trainer assignment history for a member
get.description:
Returns the full trainer assignment history for a member, newest first.
Includes current active assignment (if any) and all past ended assignments.
Each assignment is populated with trainer name and specializations.
Returns all active plans for the tenant, sorted by price.

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.description: Include archived plans in the response

parameters.name: planId
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the membership plan

patch.description: Updates plan details. All fields are optional. Does not affect existing subscriptions (plan snapshot is preserved).

parameters.name: planId
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the membership plan

delete.description: Soft-archives the plan. Will fail if active, frozen, or pending-payment subscriptions reference it.

parameters.name: planId
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the membership plan

200.description: Count of notifications marked as read

post.summary: Register a device FCM token for push notifications

delete.summary: Unregister a device FCM token (call on logout)

patch.summary: Mark a single notification as read

get.description: Paginated payment records. Filter by member, branch, invoice, method, or date range.

post.description:
Records a payment against an invoice. Automatically updates the invoice
status to `partially_paid` or `paid`. Amount cannot exceed the outstanding balance.

400.description: Payment exceeds amount due or invoice is void/paid

post.description:
Records a full or partial refund against a payment.
Updates payment status and reverses the invoice's amountPaid.

get.summary: Revenue report with time series and breakdown

get.description:
Returns every permission string in the system grouped by resource.
Use this to populate the permission picker in the role editor UI.

get.summary: List roles for the current tenant
get.description:
Returns both built-in and custom roles for the authenticated user's tenant.
Built-in roles are sorted first.

post.description:
Creates a new custom role for the tenant with the specified permissions.
Requires the `customRoles` feature flag to be enabled on the tenant's plan.

402.description: Feature not available on current plan

patch.description: Update name, description, or permissions. Built-in roles cannot be modified.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes a custom role.
Built-in roles cannot be deleted.
Will fail if any users are still assigned to this role.

post.summary: Assign a role to a user
post.description:
Assigns a custom role to a user within the tenant.
The user's `customPermissions` are updated to match the role's permissions.
Changes take effect on the user's next login (new JWT issued).
Only one custom role can be active per user at a time — re-assigning overwrites the previous.

delete.summary: Remove custom role from a user
delete.description:
Clears the user's custom role assignment, reverting them to their
default built-in role permissions. Takes effect on next login.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: User ID to remove the custom role from

get.summary: List all staff users (branch_manager, staff, trainer)

post.description:
Creates a User account with role branch_manager, staff, or trainer.
The user will be required to change their password on first login.
For trainers, use the returned userId to create a TrainerProfile separately.

get.summary: Get a staff user by ID

get.description: Aggregated tenant counts, plan breakdown, recent sign-ups, and pending invoices.
Paginated list of tenants with optional filtering by status, plan, or search term.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by business name or contact email

post.description:
Creates a new tenant with an initial Gym Owner account and first SaaS invoice.
The operation is atomic — all three documents are created in a single transaction.
The Gym Owner receives their credentials by email and must change their password on first login.

get.description: Returns full tenant details including the associated Gym Owner's profile.

patch.description: Update business name, contact info, or country. All fields are optional.

Suspend, reactivate, or terminate a tenant account.
A reason is always required for audit trail purposes.
Termination is irreversible.

Upgrades or downgrades a tenant to a different SaaS plan.
Plan quotas and feature flags are updated immediately.

post.description:
Issues a short-lived (1h) access token scoped to the tenant's Gym Owner.
The token carries `impersonating: true` and `impersonatorId` for audit tracing.
Use the returned token as the Bearer token to operate as that tenant.
All actions taken during impersonation are logged in the audit trail.

get.summary: List SaaS invoices for a tenant

post.summary: Mark a SaaS invoice as paid
post.description: Records a manual payment (bank transfer, cheque, etc.) against a pending invoice.

get.description: Returns all plans sorted by price (starter → pro → enterprise).

put.summary: Create or update a SaaS plan
put.description:
Upserts the plan definition for the given plan tier.
Changes to quotas and feature flags take effect immediately for **new** tenants.
Existing tenants retain their current plan settings until explicitly re-assigned.

parameters.name: planName
parameters.description: Plan tier to create or update

post.description:
Creates both a User account (role: trainer) AND a TrainerProfile in one atomic transaction.
This eliminates the need for separate /staff calls from frontend.

monthlyRate.description: Monthly salary/rate for the trainer (replaces hourlyRate)

get.description: Paginated list of trainers for the tenant. Supports filtering by branch, status, specialization, and availability.

parameters.name: availableOnly
parameters.description: Filter to trainers with remaining client capacity

post.description:
Creates a trainer profile linked to an existing User account with role `trainer`.
The user must already exist with role `trainer` in the same tenant.

get.description: Returns full trainer profile including linked user details.

patch.description: Updates trainer details including branches, specializations, availability, and status.

delete.description: Soft-archives the trainer profile and ends all active assignments.

get.description: Returns all assignments (active and historical) for a trainer. Filter by ?status=active|ended

post.summary: Assign a member to a trainer
post.description:
Creates a new trainer-member assignment.
If the member already has an active assignment with another trainer,
that assignment is automatically ended (reassigned).
Enforces trainer capacity (`maxClients`).

400.description: Trainer at full capacity or not active

patch.description:
Updates the PT charge, goal, session frequency, or notes on an active assignment.
Does not change the trainer — use POST /assignments to reassign.

post.description:
Ends an active assignment and decrements the trainer's client count.
The assignment is preserved in history with the end date and optional reason.

get.description:
Returns session notes written by this trainer.
Trainers can only see their own notes.
Staff/managers see all notes.

post.description:
Records a session note for a member.
Trainers must have an active assignment with the member.

403.description: No active assignment with this member

patch.description: Trainers can only edit their own notes. Staff can edit any note.

get.description: Returns all visible ratings for a trainer, sorted newest first.

post.summary: Submit or update a trainer rating
post.description:
Submits a rating from a member for a trainer.
If the member has already rated this trainer, the existing rating is updated (upsert).
The trainer's `ratingAvg` and `ratingCount` are recalculated automatically.

get.summary: Get workout calendar for a month
Get day detail with exercises and nutrition
